purpose: Explicit higher-effort preference for a parent coordinating concurrent workers; no quality or cost comparison claim

instruction_changes.deviation: Current delegation contract pins bounded worker medium and linear high but does not require high effort for a parent coordinating parallel workers.
instruction_changes.evidence: User: a model that parallelizes needs a higher thinking budget, this should be in the delegation rule. Existing durable task was dispatched at configured worker effort before this correction.
instruction_changes.why_instruction: Explicit cross-host delegation preference belongs in the existing model and dispatch owner, loaded before dispatch. Reuse linear high instead of adding a schema role or changing leaf defaults.
instruction_changes.alternative: No change omits the requested preference. Raising every worker/default increases scope. A runtime override alone does not persist future delegation decisions.

near_miss: Single bounded worker remains medium; independent reviewer remains high; native default settings and running-session identity unchanged.
